prompt:

Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a sequined jazz dance leotard with a short flared skirt — in warm taupe; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body facing the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands cup her chin, her forearms propped beneath her.
LEGS: lower legs raised behind her, ankles loosely crossed.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Figure: strong and broad-shouldered with firm muscle, yet full-busted with wide rounded hips and a defined waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
